lines.beaver_en: Hi! How are you doing these days?
lines.learner: 잘 지내요. 그런데 요즘 좀 바빠요.
lines.en: I'm doing well. But I'm a bit busy lately.
lines.roman: jal jinaeyo. geureonde yojeum jom bappayo.

lines.beaver_en: Really? What time do you get up in the morning?
lines.learner: 일곱 시에 일어나요. 그리고 세수를 해요.
lines.en: I get up at seven. Then I wash my face.
lines.roman: ilgop sie ireonayo. geurigo sesureul haeyo.

lines.beaver_en: When do you take a shower?
lines.en: I shower at home in the evening.
Yes, I always eat. I eat bread.

lines.beaver_en: What do you do during the day?
Are you busy on weekends too?
lines.en: No, I'm free on weekends. I rest at home.

lines.beaver_en: What else do you do on weekends?
lines.en: On Sundays, I go to the public bathhouse.

lines.beaver_en: What time do you go to bed at night?
lines.learner: 열한 시에 자요. 잠을 푹 자요.
lines.en: I sleep at eleven. I sleep deeply.
lines.roman: yeolhan sie jayo. jameul puk jayo.

lines.beaver_en: What time do your parents go to sleep?
lines.en: My parents go to sleep at ten.

lines.beaver_en: You have a regular routine. Let's talk again!
